lines.text: The high priest Ananias and some elders brought a lawyer named Tertullus, who called Paul a ringleader of the Nazarenes.
Tertullus opened by telling Felix that they enjoyed lasting peace and that his foresight had brought improvements to the nation.
Paul told the governor that he had gone up to Jerusalem to worship no more than seven days earlier.
Felix adjourned the hearing until Lysias the commander came, and ordered Paul kept under guard.
Felix hoped for a bribe from Paul, and after two years he was succeeded by Pontius Pilate.
